minutes.headline: Select Board approved outdoor seating for three restaurants and annual appointments, and bid farewell to two retiring members.
minutes.summary: Last meeting for two retiring selectmen, who were thanked at length. The board heard a climate resilience (MVP) presentation, approved a liquor manager change, outdoor seating for three businesses, and annual appointments after debate over the appointment process. Members also debated earth removal after the failed town meeting article, and adjourned.

public_comment.topic: Thanked the retiring selectmen and mentioned the weekend election and write-in candidate list.
Complained that cemeteries were not mowed for Memorial Day; asked the board to investigate and report, and asked the town manager to delegate control of cemetery functions to the commissioners.
Applicant for change of manager of the liquor license.
Public access cable committee member thanked the board, said the education channel comes online Thursday, and renewed request for a permanent studio space.

what_happened.line: The Select Board approved outdoor seating for three businesses: Donnelly's Tavern, Smokestack Roasters and American Graffiti, which also included alcohol sales.
The board approved the annual appointments as presented, after debate over the appointment process, and ratified the town manager's police officer appointments.
The board authorized the chair to sign the purchase and sale agreement and closing documents for 17 and 23 West Street.
The board agreed to put earth removal authority and enforcement on a future agenda, with the building commissioner invited, after the failed town meeting article.
Outdoor seating reviews for Kindred Spirits and Lakeview Club were postponed to the next Tuesday meeting, and a liquor license manager change was approved.

why_it_matters: The West Street sale authorization and the earth removal discussion touch town-owned property and land use rules, which residents may later be asked to vote on at Town Meeting.
Outdoor seating approvals let three local businesses use outdoor space under the board's license conditions, and two more reviews are still pending.
watch_next: Next Tuesday's meeting: outdoor seating reviews for Kindred Spirits and Lakeview Club, board reorganization, and the North Worcester County Pride video submission.
A future agenda item on earth removal authority and enforcement, with the building commissioner invited; no date was given.
